title: That Old Black Magic: Hermy and Bass
start: Speak to Lady Grey in the City of Um's bandstand about her drummer.
prereq_quests: That Old Black Magic: My One and Only Lute

items.t: Animated drumsticks (may obtain during the quest)

kills.t: Multiple kills of Hermod, the Spirit of War (level 732)

steps.t: Talk to Lady Grey about the drummer. [Chat: ? Drummer.]
Kill Hermod, the Spirit of War until you receive animated drumsticks.

sub.t: Requires 65 Necromancy and completion of The Spirit of War.

steps.t: Talk to the The Spirit of Rhythm.
Unequip items from both hand slots and talk to Ed. [Chat: 1 Take a boat out onto the lake.]

sub.t: He's in the boat rental shop east of the northernmost docks.

steps.t: Manifest the animated drumsticks and a splash will appear at the location of a lost drum. Refer to the location maps below.
p: Splashes appear when manifesting the drumsticks.

steps.t: Continue to manifest the animated drumsticks until you have found all four drums.
Return to the bandstand and talk to the The Spirit of Rhythm.
